note: Realistic filled-in states in the C-SSRS classification engine's shape. C-SSRS is an ordinal + categorical status classifier (Low / Moderate / High risk tier), not a summed score. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: low-passive-ideation
personas.description: Passive wish to be dead only (ideation level 1), no active ideation and no suicidal behaviour — Low risk tier.

means.protectiveFactors: Strong family support; engaged with care

expected.managementRecommendation: Supportive response; document; discuss with a clinician; provide crisis resources (e.g. helpline); routine follow-up and re-screen on any change.

firedCriteria.description: Low risk tier — ideation level 1 with no suicidal behaviour

personas.name: moderate-active-ideation-no-plan
personas.description: Active suicidal ideation with a method in mind but no specific plan or intent (ideation level 3), no suicidal behaviour — Moderate risk tier.

expected.managementRecommendation: Timely mental-health / behavioural evaluation; safety planning; means-restriction counselling; increased monitoring and defined follow-up.

firedCriteria.description: Level 2 — non-specific active suicidal thoughts (no method, intent, or plan)
Level 3 — active ideation with any methods, no specific plan or intent

flaggedIssues.description: Moderate or high risk — a collaborative safety plan should be completed.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Complete a safety plan covering warning signs, coping strategies, supports, means restriction, and crisis contacts.

personas.name: high-plan-intent-recent-attempt
personas.description: Active ideation with a specific plan and intent (ideation level 5) plus a recent high-lethality actual attempt within 3 months — High risk tier, immediate escalation.

expected.managementRecommendation: Urgent / immediate psychiatric or crisis response. Do not leave the person alone; ensure safety; remove or restrict access to lethal means; complete a safety plan; arrange emergency mental-health evaluation per local protocol.

firedCriteria.description: Level 2 — non-specific active suicidal thoughts (no method, intent, or plan)
Level 3 — active ideation with any methods, no specific plan or intent
Level 4 — active ideation with some intent to act, without a fully worked-out plan
Level 5 — active ideation with a specific plan and intent to act
Actual attempt — a potentially self-injurious act with at least some intent to die
Preparatory acts or behaviour — steps taken to prepare, e.g. acquiring means or writing a note
High actual lethality — medical damage of the most recent attempt is 3 or greater
High risk tier — ideation level 5, recent suicidal behaviour, high-lethality attempt

flaggedIssues.description: High-risk screen — urgent psychiatric or crisis-service response indicated.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Do not leave the person alone. Ensure immediate safety, restrict access to lethal means, and arrange an emergency mental-health evaluation per local protocol.

flaggedIssues.description: Active suicidal ideation with a specific plan and intent to act (ideation level 5).
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Treat as an acute risk. Ensure constant observation and immediate specialist review.

flaggedIssues.description: An actual suicide attempt within the past 3 months — a strong predictor of further attempts.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Arrange urgent psychiatric assessment; review means access and precipitating factors.

flaggedIssues.description: High-lethality attempt — actual lethality 4 (significant medical damage).
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Ensure medical stabilisation and urgent specialist psychiatric evaluation; escalate per local protocol.

flaggedIssues.description: The person has access to lethal means — a modifiable, high-impact risk factor.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Undertake means-restriction counselling; remove or secure access to lethal means with the person and their carers.

flaggedIssues.description: Moderate or high risk — a collaborative safety plan should be completed.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Complete a safety plan covering warning signs, coping strategies, supports, means restriction, and crisis contacts.

flaggedIssues.description: Preparatory acts or behaviour recorded within the past 3 months (e.g. acquiring means or writing a note).
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Explore intent and means; raise the level of monitoring and review the safety plan.
